title: Repair Estimates & Appointments Written Estimate Validity and Revision Allowances
content:
Once a Repair Estimates & Appointments estimate is written, the estimate type fixes how long it can be converted to a repair order and how many revisions (re-inspections) the booking allows, and within what window.

| Estimate type | Validity (calendar days after the estimate written date) | Revisions allowed per booking | Revision window (calendar days after the estimate written date) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Photo Estimate | 30 | 1 | 14 |
| Drive-In Estimate | 30 | 1 | 14 |
| Scheduled Estimate | 30 | 2 | 30 |
| Mobile Estimate | 30 | 1 | 14 |
| Blueprint Teardown Estimate | 45 | 2 | 30 |
| Structural Blueprint Estimate | 45 | 3 | 30 |

- **Validity** — the calendar days after the estimate written date during which the estimate can be converted to a repair order.
- **Revisions allowed per booking** — the number of estimate revisions (re-inspections) allowed on one booking.
- **Revision window** — the calendar days after the estimate written date within which a revision may be requested.

Points of comparison: the two teardown types hold an estimate for 45 days against 30 days for the other four; the Structural Blueprint Estimate alone allows 3 revisions; the Scheduled Estimate and both teardown types give a 30-day revision window, the others 14 days.
